structured_output.summary: src/ui/title.css: `.ui-start__cards` used to have a -12px margin on every side. Its right margin is now 0 (`margin: calc(var(--space-s3) * -1) 0 calc(var(--space-s3) * -1) calc(var(--space-s3) * -1)`), so the scroll box's clip edge stops at the content edge, in line with RACE, and no longer reaches into the right safe inset (§5: max(48px, env)). The padding is unchanged, so the last card's shadow and focus ring still have room at the end of the scroll. The left, top and bottom still extend 12px for the shadow, the lift and the focus ring. I updated the CSS comment to match. New test tests/ui/card-row-safe-inset.test.ts renders 'track-select--many-cards' in Chromium at 844×390 (touch) and 1440×900. It checks that no card is visible past RACE's right edge, and on the phone not past 844−48. Before the fix it failed at both sizes (808 on the phone, 1420 vs 1408.5 on desktop). After the fix it passes. pnpm typecheck passes and pnpm test passes (159 files, 875 tests). In the screenshots the eight-card peek now clips at x≈796, aligned with RACE, and the four-card start--menu still fits with shadows visible.
